IT MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 9.2 NM IN LENGTH, AND 0.35 NM AT THE WIDEST POINT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE OUT OF THE SSW AT 12 KTS AND ALIGNED WITH THE TRAJECTORY OF THE ANOMALY. UNCERTAINTIES: MULTIPLE OIL FACILITIES AND PIPELINES WERE IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE SLICK, AND THEREFORE, A SPECIFIC SOURCE COULD NOT BE CONFIRMED.
